python.code:
# 临时换源
# pip install requests -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
# 永久换源（~/.pip/pip.conf）:
# [global]
# index-url = https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple
python.content: pip 默认从 PyPI 官方源下载，国内可换清华/阿里镜像源提速。用 -i 参数临时指定，或写 pip.conf 永久生效。pip install -U pip 保持 pip 自身最新。
python.title: pip 换源加速

sql.code:
SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS c
FROM orders
GROUP BY user_id
ORDER BY c DESC
LIMIT 1;
sql.content: GROUP BY + COUNT + ORDER BY + LIMIT 1 是找"最多"的标准模式。配合 HAVING 可加条件，如 HAVING c > 10。
sql.title: 找最大值对应的行
